definitions.gloss: sound of wings; flapping or buzzing sound of wings
definitions.explanation: The sound made by the wings of birds or insects in flight. Can refer to flapping, beating, or buzzing sounds depending on the creature.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}の{羽音|はおと}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard the sound of a bird's wings.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}の{羽音|はおと}が{耳元|みみもと}で{鳴|な}っている。
examples.english: The buzzing of a bee is sounding near my ear.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かな{森|もり}の{中|なか}で、{突然|とつぜん}{大|おお}きな{羽音|はおと}がして{見上|みあ}げると、{白鷺|しらさぎ}が{飛|と}び{立|た}つところだった。
examples.english: In the quiet forest, there was suddenly a loud sound of wings, and when I looked up, a white heron was taking flight.

notes:
USAGE:
A poetic and evocative word frequently used in literature and nature writing. The sound varies depending on the creature: {鳥|とり}の{羽音|はおと} (flapping of bird wings) versus {蜂|はち}の{羽音|はおと} (buzzing of bee wings).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽音|はおと}がする (to make a wing sound)
- {羽音|はおと}を{立|た}てる (to produce the sound of wings)
- {羽音|はおと}が{聞|き}こえる (to hear the sound of wings)
